svg.title: P14N contiguous underway averaging footprints
svg.desc: Six panels compare northern and southern branch eastward means at fixed 30, 60 and 150 minute windows for all three ship-speed cutoffs. Horizontal bars show contributor latitude footprints, not uncertainty. Hollow markers have less than 80 percent time coverage. All 126 boundary scenarios lack two resolved sides. No physical current width is admitted. Numeric bins and the complete scenario results are in research/aleutian-p14n-1993-underway-averages.json.
